followUp.question: If the net force on the same 3 kg object were doubled, what would be the new acceleration?
followUp.explanation: Since F = ma, acceleration is directly proportional to the net force when mass is constant. Doubling the force doubles the acceleration (2 * 4 m/s² = 8 m/s²).
